## Core Mission & Platform Overview
Sanatana360 preserves and makes accessible ancient Indian knowledge, temple heritage, Vedic sciences, and sacred rituals in high definition. It provides 100% ad-free, family-safe screen time for ₹1.09/day (₹29 trial).
